description: Represents a code block / program listing as ONE code block, preserving its verbatim text and formatting.
applicability: The region is source code, a program listing, a command/terminal snippet, or pseudo-code (often monospaced / fenced).
Whitespace and line breaks are significant.
instructions: Emit each code block as ONE block of block_type code, preserving the code VERBATIM including indentation and line breaks; do not reflow or 'fix' it.
Keep the whole listing as one block; do NOT split it across sibling blocks by line, and do NOT treat code lines as list items or paragraphs.
Never paraphrase or summarize code into prose.

provenance.reason: General-document adaptation (MPDocBench): technical documents contain code blocks that must be preserved verbatim.
